title: rec-c2.0-eventbus-inventory
summary: Opens REC-C2. Machine-readable inventory of every production EventBus / legacy-queue coupling (37 occurrences: 26 COMPATIBILITY, 11 CANONICAL) plus a four-rule ratchet wired into the architecture gate. Six characterizations measure today's reality: dual_push publishes to the bus before a best-effort log append (CHAR-C2-01); observe(list) drains fired evidence globally (CHAR-C2-02); retained_until_session_end destroys rather than retains (CHAR-C2-03); fire_count is never incremented (CHAR-C2-04); the fired buffer has no consumer scoping (CHAR-C2-05); probe_stop/session_snapshot read the bus destructively (CHAR-C2-06). No runtime behavior change.

findings_detail.FIND-C2.0-01: retained_until_session_end is a lie: observe(list) drains fired_buffer before applying retention and then returns []. Measured by CHAR-C2-03. REC-C2.1 must make it truly retained (consumer cursor over immutable evidence) or reject it as Unsupported.
findings_detail.FIND-C2.0-02: Tripwire.fire_count is never incremented by any firing path (evaluate builds TripwireFired from &self; nothing writes back). Measured by CHAR-C2-04. REC-C2.1 must derive the count from persisted evidence.
findings_detail.FIND-C2.0-03: check_architecture_contracts.py was RED on main@063cbdf8 (pre-existing): TRUTH-001/002/003 are status=verified but lacked the policy-required uat field. Repaired in-cycle (minimum patch) by adding the uat arrays; the UATs already existed and were named in notes.
